course.name: Models & Profiles: Your AI Toolkit
course.description: Configure an AI model, check its capabilities, and switch between profiles.
course.longDescription: Prerequisite: Welcome to Flow-Like. Use Desktop with access to the model catalog. A hosted model may require a provider account; local practice requires supported hardware and enough disk space. Core: 25 minutes. Optional offline check: 7 minutes, excluding download time. Configure and test one model, then document which model each job needs. Checks are manual.

lessons.title: Assign a model to a Profile

challenges.prompt: A local model is downloaded but absent from the active Profile’s picker. What should you check?
challenges.explanation: Local files and Profile membership are separate setup steps.

options.label: Whether it was added to this Profile
Whether the App was renamed
Whether a public listing was submitted

challenges.prompt: A task must inspect a screenshot. What is the decisive first check?
challenges.explanation: The required input modality must be supported by the actual configuration.

options.label: Whether its name contains Pro
Whether it has the largest text context
Whether this configured model accepts image input

challenges.prompt: You replace the embedding model used for a notes index. What must you plan?
challenges.explanation: Index and query vectors must share the same embedding space and configuration.

options.label: Replace the speech model only
Rebuild the index with the matching model/configuration
Keep old vectors because any vectors are comparable

challenges.prompt: The selected model runs on-device. Does that prove every node in the workflow avoids the network?
challenges.explanation: Model execution location describes inference, while other workflow steps have their own dependencies.

options.label: No; other nodes may still call remote services
Yes; the model controls all node networking
Yes; an offline download disables HTTP nodes

lessons.title: Switch and diagnose the active setup

challenges.prompt: Switching Profile does not change the model used by a node. What should you inspect?
challenges.explanation: A hard-coded model selection is not replaced merely by changing active Profile settings.

options.label: The App’s storage folder name
The placement of the node on the canvas
Whether the node selects by preference or names a specific model

challenges.prompt: Profile settings restore on a new laptop, but its local model cannot load. Which missing step is plausible?
challenges.explanation: Restoring settings does not put local model files on the new device.

options.label: Rename the Profile to Offline
Download the model files on that laptop and check hardware support
Create a second copy of every App

challenges.prompt: The toolkit can draft text but has no configured audio-input path. Which requirement is still unmet?
challenges.explanation: Text drafting does not by itself provide speech-to-text capability.

options.label: Transcribing the recording
Keeping Apps in My Apps
Switching the theme
